newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EU sees 13 states meeting EMU budget goal - paper.
newsitem.headline: EU sees 13 states meeting EMU budget goal - paper.

text.p: The European Commission expects all European Union countries except Italy and Greece to meet budget deficit targets for the single currency, the Diario Economico newspaper asaid on Tuesday, citing a draft report.
In a report from Brussels, the financial newspaper said that it had had access to the latest version of the Commission's findings which will be published on Wednesday.

The Commission is significantly more optimistic than in the spring when a similar survey saw seven countries qualifying. But the paper added that changes to the report could still be made during EU Monetary Committee meetings set for Tuesday.

The budget targets are one of five economic tests for Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) which candidates must satisfy next year in order to qualify for the launch of the single currency in January 1999.
Budget deficits must be no more than three percent of gross domestic product (GDP).
The newspaper gave no further details about the contents of the Commission report.
